user.title: Bambu Lab account
user.description: Sign in with your Bambu Lab account to access your cloud filament library. The password is only sent to Bambu Lab and is not stored.

code.title: Verification code
code.description: Bambu Lab sent a verification code to {email}. Enter it here. If it did not arrive, leave the field empty and enable "Request new code".

tfa.title: Two-factor authentication
tfa.description: Enter the code from your authenticator app.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed - check email and password.
error.code_incorrect: The code was not accepted - try again.
error.code_resent: A new code was sent - check your inbox and enter it above.
error.cloudflare: Blocked by Cloudflare bot protection - try again later.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Bambu cloud.

data.include_inactive: Also create devices for inactive spools

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Fetch the filament library from the Bambu cloud immediately.

set_remaining.name: Set remaining weight
set_remaining.description: Set the remaining filament weight of a spool in the cloud library.

spool_id.name: Spool ID
spool_id.description: The cloud id of the spool (see the spool sensor's spool_id attribute).

remaining_g.name: Remaining weight
remaining_g.description: New remaining filament weight in grams (without the spool itself).

set_note.name: Set note
set_note.description: Set the note of a spool in the cloud library.

spool_id.name: Spool ID
spool_id.description: The cloud id of the spool (see the spool sensor's spool_id attribute).

create_spool.name: Create spool
create_spool.description: Add a new spool to the Bambu cloud filament library (appears in Studio/Handy too).

material.name: Material
material.description: Material type, e.g. PLA or PETG.

name.name: Filament name
name.description: Product line name, e.g. PLA Matte.

remaining_g.name: Remaining weight
remaining_g.description: Current remaining grams (defaults to the spool size).

filament_id.name: Filament ID
filament_id.description: Optional Bambu filament id (e.g. GFA01); resolved automatically for official filaments.

delete_spool.name: Delete spool
delete_spool.description: Delete a spool from the Bambu cloud filament library.

spool_id.name: Spool ID
spool_id.description: The cloud id of the spool to delete.
